# L&R Design & Build LTD

Official website: https://lrdesignandbuild.uk/
Based in: Wigan / Greater Manchester, United Kingdom
Phone: 07507 705621
Email: lrdesignandbuildltd@yahoo.com

L&R Design & Build LTD is a building and construction company serving Wigan and the North West. Core services include house extensions, new build homes, brickwork, groundworks, drainage, renovations, landscaping, fencing, driveways, patios, flagging, garden rooms and garage conversions.

Priority service areas include Wigan, Leigh, Manchester, Salford, Warrington, Lymm, Wilmslow, Macclesfield, Liverpool and Bolton.

The business provides free quotations. Useful enquiry details include the job type, project location, planning or drawings if available, whether planning is approved, and the preferred project timescale.
